workarounds.verification: Build a temporary Linux runner without the Impeller opt-out. On NVIDIA/Wayland and X11 maximize, resize and restore repeatedly; no EGL/GDK crash or stalled frame is allowed.
workarounds.decision: Keep: upstream #191775 remains open; native Wayland reproduction is required before removal.

workarounds.verification: Without follow_subsurface_scale, move a Linux/Wayland window between 100% and 200% monitors in both directions and change a monitor scale while running. Content must fill the window and pointer coordinates must match.
workarounds.decision: Keep: upstream #196476 remains open; static wiring tests cannot establish correct compositor behavior.

workarounds.verification: Verify the pinned SDK contains the engine fix from Flutter PR #192522 (cf75578ba90fbbc9571c653ba5a0ed79c73fee8a). In a temporary macOS release build enable Impeller; exercise A/B/A resize, native fullscreen with video, idle/foreground and display hot-plug without Canvas::SetupRenderPass crashes.
workarounds.decision: Keep: #185394 closed on 2026-11-23 through #192522, but cf75578ba90fbbc9571c653ba5a0ed79c73fee8a is not an ancestor of the pinned framework ab2912035e160d9cad6306df307576da6128ebdb. Closure alone does not fix Flutter 3.50.0.

workarounds.verification: Verify the unpatched pinned SDK contains b304cf18b6864d141cf08e26a07898901cddb4b5 or an equivalent fix. Run the upstream semantics_update_test.dart orphan/traversal-parent regressions and a macOS release with VoiceOver/AX queries, route transitions and pointer movement. Remove the wrapper, patch, build invocation and modification notice together after validation.
workarounds.decision: Keep: the merged #193372 fix b304cf18b6864d141cf08e26a07898901cddb4b5 is not an ancestor of Flutter 3.50.0 revision ab2912035e160d9cad6306df307576da6128ebdb; engine recovery report #196872 remains open.
